facts.value: AI is already changing how architecture research, drafting, image generation, visualization, and option testing happen. It can speed up repetitive work and surface more possibilities early.

What it still cannot replace well is judgment. Architecture is full of trade-offs, context, culture, human behavior, negotiation, and the ability to decide what matters most when every constraint is pushing in a different direction.
AI will matter in architecture, but mostly as a tool. It can help architects move faster. It does not remove the need for architects to think.
